summary: The ASMPlacements class in HSPnet.DataLayer provides functionality for handling ASM placement data. It includes methods for retrieving data by timetable ID and committing worksheet assignments.
purpose: To manage ASM placement retrieval and worksheet assignment within the HSPnet framework.

workflows.name: ASM Placement Retrieval
steps: Invoke GetByTimetableID with timetableID and iteration

workflows.name: ASM Worksheet Assignment
steps: Invoke WorksheetAssignASMCommit with timetableID, groupFlag, and iteration
Return success status based on SQL error occurrence

system_behavior: System executes stored procedures for data retrieval and assignment actions.
System returns placement data or success status based on the execution result.
